name: Archetype Arcadia
original_name: アーキタイプ・アーカディア
source:
The world has fallen to Peccato Mania (original sin), which causes the victims to have urges of harming themselves and others.

To save his younger sister Christine, who has been afflicted with the disease, Rust logs in to the full-dive online game “Archetype Arcadia,” which is the sole means of stopping the disease’s advancement.

Hope, grief, joy, betrayal, and inescapable “death” are found in this game, where players convert their memories into avatars and fight.

This is a fully-voiced text novel adventure game that tells a ghastly story of overwhelming volume, guided by memories that should have been lost.

[From [url=https://www.gematsu.com/2021/07/kemco-and-water-phoenix-officially-announce-apocalyptic-virtual-world-visual-novel-archetype-arcadia-for-ps5-ps4-and-switch]Gematsu[/url]]
translation:
世界陷入了Peccato Mania（原罪），这导致受害者有伤害自己和他人的冲动。

为了拯救被疾病折磨的妹妹克里斯汀，鲁斯特登录了全潜式网络游戏《Archetype Arcadia》，这是阻止疾病蔓延的唯一手段。

希望、悲伤、喜悦、背叛和不可避免的“死亡”都在这款游戏中找到，玩家将记忆转化为化身并进行战斗。

这是一款全语音文字小说冒险游戏，以本应丢失的记忆为引导，讲述了一个数量巨大的恐怖故事。

[来自[url=https://www.gematsu.com/2021/07/kemco-and-water-phoenix-officially-announce-apocalyptic-virtual-world-visual-novel-archetype-arcadia-for-ps5-ps4-and-switch]Gematsu[/url]]
